== Notes ==
* The health gain only occurs on a ''successful'' hit. Consider combining with [[Otyugh's Cry]].
* The attack speed boost can help to land time sensitive pet attacks ([[Disrupting Lunge]] or [[Bestial Pounce]], for example).
* This skill can be used when your pet is dead.
{{bug|Contrary to the descriptions, this skill causes healing and not [[health gain]].}}

== Trivia ==
* The woman in the [[skill icon]] appears to be the same one in the [[Heal as One]] icon.
* The functionality of this skill has changed since its introduction; see its [[Predatory Bond/Skill history|PvE]] skill history for details.
